title: 第3015章 骤闻扑面金风急第3014章 赤妩所藏四
content_zh:
陈家和杨家作为青州的两个顶尖家族，关系说不上好也说不上坏，之前因为陈玉芝对杨芸的心思，所有两家即使有冲突也都没有摆在明面上。
但是如果替天行道对自己有极大好处，那么些许风险也就可以无视了。
龙行的话音刚落，便只见祥公子的身体突然一震，脚下当即一顿身形一滞，五官揪紧，脸上显出痛苦之色。
不管怎么样，他手持的风云令就是最好的倚仗，秦岚也肯定不会直接将他拒之千里。
而且古人成婚极早，有的十三十岁便开始怀孕生子，这就导致了成活率极低，哪怕是皇家里头，幼子夭折的事情，也是司空见惯。
“我不需要代表掠影家族。”
木公环视一周，又看向白无双，“我只是让你们注意点。”
他说得很模糊，让人摸不清他是否能够代表掠影家族。
隐士道魂从身材等来看，都与刘枫宝有着很大的区别，不过，气质到有点相同。
他希望这些听众能给他一些合理的建议，并且修改他计划中一些有误的地方，现在的情况并不乐观，他必须把众人的智慧结合在一起才行。
“我的命令就是你们要和我做交易！
我来保证你们的安全，而你们要服从于我！
听明白了吗？”
白狼有些兴奋的说道。
城墙上的卫兵似乎察觉到了什么，低头向下方看去，等待他的是白狼的血盆大口，白狼爪子扒着城墙的突出部，直接咬住了卫兵的脖子，倒霉的精灵卫兵连尖叫都没有发出，就被白狼扭断了脖子。
浅雪慕素走了过来，坐在床边，她的心里满是离别之情，一时之间不知如何是好。
虽然二人日常里亲昵举动不少，但是从未有今晚这般，略显得尴尬。
二人来到城防营，由阿特将军手持王杖，要求城防守将柯来罗单独接受王令。
不过它的身份还是狼质，甩干净身上的杂草泥土，又跑过来献媚撒娇。
夜十一举手格挡，没想红爪如钢铁一般坚硬，噹的一声将他击飞了出去。

熟悉的景色出现在眼前，第一刻范重甚至都认为自己的意识还在刚刚的黑暗空间，但是就在他想要将手抬起的的时候，却感觉到凝滞感。
在范重清醒的时候，他身下的阴瞳突然闪现了一下，而范重并没有注意，此时的他一阵后怕，刚刚如果不是二哈的突然出现，他就可能沦落为一个傀儡了。
此时范重又回想起，在回忆空间见到的一幕，以及最后金翅啸日虎对自己的嘱咐，请求自己的救助。
月氏人见乌桓百夫长只要一匹马代步，这才放下心来，欢笑着走了。
眼眸莫名湿润，江绯色连能敷衍的借口也找不到，只能侧过脸迅速抹掉。
苏杭依言将双手平伸，全力运转真元。
只见老者伸手紧贴在苏杭的胸前，随后运转真元在手上，顿时一块令牌随着他的手掌从他的胸前浮出。
“杜先生不在家，你有什么事情跟我说吧，等他回来，我告诉他。”
那佣人毫不客气地说道。
content_en:
As the two top families in Qingzhou, the relationship between the Chen family and the Yang family could not be said to be good or bad. In the past, due to Chen Yuzhi's thoughts about Yang Yun, even if the two families had conflicts, they did not put it openly.
But if acting on behalf of Heaven is of great benefit to you, then some risks can be ignored.
As soon as Long Xing finished speaking, Mr. Xiang's body suddenly shook. His feet immediately froze, his facial features clenched, and a look of pain appeared on his face.
No matter what, the Fengyun Token he holds is his best support, and Qin Lan will definitely not reject him directly.
Moreover, the ancients got married very early, and some began to conceive and have children at the age of thirty or thirty, which resulted in a very low survival rate. Even among the royal family, it was common for young children to die in infancy.
"I don't need to represent the Glimpse family."
Mu Gong looked around and then looked at Bai Wushuang, "I just want you to pay attention."
He spoke very vaguely, making it unclear whether he could represent the Glimpse family.
Hermit Daohun is very different from Liu Fengbao in terms of body shape, etc., but his temperament is somewhat the same.
He hoped that these audiences could give him some reasonable suggestions and correct some errors in his plan. The current situation was not optimistic and he had to combine the wisdom of everyone.
“My order is that you must make a deal with me!
I'm here to keep you safe, and you have to obey me!
Do you understand? "
Bai Lang said excitedly.
The guard on the city wall seemed to have noticed something. He lowered his head and looked down. What was waiting for him was the white wolf's bloody mouth. The white wolf clawed at the protruding part of the city wall and bit the guard's neck directly. The unlucky elf guard didn't even scream, and his neck was broken by the white wolf.
Qianxue Musu came over and sat beside the bed. Her heart was full of parting feelings, and she didn't know what to do for a moment.
Although the two of them had a lot of intimacy in their daily lives, it had never been like this tonight, which seemed a little awkward.
The two came to the city defense camp. General Art held the royal staff and asked the city defense general Colai Luo to accept the king's order alone.
However, its identity is still that of a wolf. It shakes off the weeds and dirt on its body, and then runs over to flatter and act coquettishly.
Ye Shiyi raised his hand to block. Unexpectedly, the red claws were as hard as steel and knocked him away with a bang.
A familiar scene appeared in front of him. For the first moment, Fan Zhong even thought that his consciousness was still in the dark space. But just when he wanted to raise his hand, he felt stagnant.
When Fan Zhong was awake, the dark eyes under his body suddenly flashed, but Fan Zhong didn't pay attention. At this time, he was afraid. If Er Ha hadn't suddenly appeared just now, he might have become a puppet.
At this time, Fan Zhong recalled the scene he saw in the memory space, as well as the last instructions given to him by the Golden-winged Sun-Screaming Tiger, asking for his help.
When the Yuezhi people saw that Centurion Wuhuan only needed a horse to travel, they felt relieved and left with a smile.
His eyes were inexplicably moist, and Jiang Feise couldn't even find an excuse to deal with it, so he could only wipe it away quickly by turning his face.
Su Hang followed the instructions and stretched out his hands flatly, using all his strength to activate his true energy.
The old man stretched out his hand and put it close to Su Hang's chest, and then moved his true energy into his hand. Suddenly, a token emerged from his chest with his palm.
"Mr. Du is not at home. If you have anything to do, tell me. I will tell him when he comes back."
The servant said unceremoniously.
